title: Stop name vs. destination weight split
description: Stop name stays at weight 800 while destination headsigns drop to 600, giving the header and row text two clearly distinct weight tiers instead of the current 800/700 near-match.

changes.intent: Keep the header at its existing top weight so it reads as the heaviest text on screen.
Drop destination weight so rows read as a distinct, lighter tier below the stop-name header.
